tissue_fc_files <- list.files(
  tissue_fc_dir, pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE
)
tissue_fc_names <- gsub(
  "_", " ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(tissue_fc_files)),
  fixed = TRUE
)
tissue_fc_names <- sub(" 1$", "", tissue_fc_names)
tissue_fc_endoderm_names <- gsub(
  "_", " ",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(
    readLines(tissue_fc_meta_endoderm_file, warn = FALSE)
  )),
  fixed = TRUE

tissue_fc_endoderm_names <- sub(" 1$", "", tissue_fc_endoderm_names)
tissue_fc_gene_lists <- lapply(tissue_fc_files, function(path) {
  read.table(
    path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

prepare_tissue_fc_plot_data <- function(fc_by_ensembl) {
  fc_data <- do.call(rbind, Map(function(tissue_genes, tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- as.character(tissue_genes$Ensembl)
    tissue_values <- unname(fc_by_ensembl[tissue_gene_ids])
    data.frame(
      tissue = rep(tissue_name, length(tissue_values)),
      gene = tissue_gene_ids,
      expression_fc = as.numeric(tissue_values),
      endoderm = rep(
        tissue_name %in% tissue_fc_endoderm_names,
        length(tissue_values)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, tissue_fc_gene_lists, tissue_fc_names))
  fc_data <- fc_data[
    is.finite(fc_data$expression_fc) & fc_data$expression_fc > 0,
  ]
  fc_universe <- fc_by_ensembl[
    is.finite(fc_by_ensembl) & fc_by_ensembl > 0
  ]
  fc_universe <- fc_universe[!duplicated(names(fc_universe))]
  test_tissues <- unique(fc_data$tissue)
  tissue_p_values <- vapply(test_tissues, function(tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- intersect(
      unique(fc_data$gene[fc_data$tissue == tissue_name]),
      names(fc_universe)
    )
    tissue_values <- unname(fc_universe[tissue_gene_ids])
    rest_values <- unname(fc_universe[
      setdiff(names(fc_universe), tissue_gene_ids)
    ])
    if (length(tissue_values) < 2 || length(rest_values) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(tissue_values, rest_values, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    )
  }, numeric(1))
  tissue_median_difference <- vapply(test_tissues, function(tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- intersect(
      unique(fc_data$gene[fc_data$tissue == tissue_name]),
      names(fc_universe)
    )
    tissue_values <- unname(fc_universe[tissue_gene_ids])
    rest_values <- unname(fc_universe[
      setdiff(names(fc_universe), tissue_gene_ids)
    ])
    median(tissue_values)-median(rest_values)
  }, numeric(1))
  tissue_adjusted_p <- p.adjust(tissue_p_values, method = "BH")
  tissue_significance_stars <- ifelse(
    is.na(tissue_adjusted_p), "",
    ifelse(
      tissue_adjusted_p < 0.001, "***",
      ifelse(
        tissue_adjusted_p < 0.01, "**",
        ifelse(tissue_adjusted_p < 0.05, "*", "")
      )
    )
  )
  tissue_significance <- ifelse(
    tissue_significance_stars == "",
    "phantom()",
    paste0(
      "phantom() ",
      ifelse(tissue_median_difference > 0, "%up%", "%down%"),
      " '", tissue_significance_stars, "'"
    )
  )
  fc_test_results <- data.frame(
    tissue = test_tissues,
    adjusted_p = tissue_adjusted_p,
    median_difference = tissue_median_difference,
    significance = tissue_significance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  fc_data$group <- factor(
    ifelse(
      fc_data$endoderm,
      "Endoderm tissue enriched genes",
      "Other tissue enriched genes"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Endoderm tissue enriched genes",
      "Other tissue enriched genes"
    )
  )

  fc_median <- tapply(
    log10(fc_data$expression_fc), fc_data$tissue, median, na.rm = TRUE
  )
  fc_order <- names(fc_median)[order(-fc_median)]
  fc_tissue_n <- table(fc_data$tissue)
  fc_low_n_tissues <- names(fc_tissue_n)[fc_tissue_n <= 10]
  fc_order <- c(
    setdiff(fc_order, fc_low_n_tissues),
    intersect(fc_order, fc_low_n_tissues)
  )
  fc_order <- c(
    setdiff(fc_order, "adipose tissue"),
    intersect("adipose tissue", fc_order)
  )
  fc_data$tissue <- factor(fc_data$tissue, levels = fc_order)
  fc_n <- table(fc_data$tissue)
  fc_multi <- fc_data[
    fc_n[as.character(fc_data$tissue)] >= 2,
  ]
  fc_single <- fc_data[
    fc_n[as.character(fc_data$tissue)] < 2,
  ]
  fc_annotations <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fc_order, function(x) {
    tissue_values <- fc_data$expression_fc[fc_data$tissue == x]
    data.frame(
      tissue = x,
      y = max(tissue_values)*1.4,
      significance_y = max(tissue_values)*1.08,
      label = paste0("n=", length(tissue_values)),
      adjusted_p = fc_test_results$adjusted_p[
        match(x, fc_test_results$tissue)
      ],
      significance = fc_test_results$significance[
        match(x, fc_test_results$tissue)
      ]
    )
  }))
  fc_annotations$tissue <- factor(
    fc_annotations$tissue, levels = fc_order
  )

  list(
    data = fc_data,
    multi = fc_multi,
    single = fc_single,
    annotations = fc_annotations
  )
}

tissue_k4fh_plot_data <- prepare_tissue_fc_plot_data(
  tissue_fc_by_ensembl
)
tissue_k1f_plot_data <- prepare_tissue_fc_plot_data(
  tissue_k1f_fc_by_ensembl
)
tissue_k3h_plot_data <- prepare_tissue_fc_plot_data(
  tissue_k3h_fc_by_ensembl
)
```

```{r tissue-fc-plot-helper, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
draw_tissue_fc_violin <- function(plot_data, plot_title) {
  ggplot(plot_data$data, aes(x = tissue, y = expression_fc)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1, color = "#666666", linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_violin(
      data = plot_data$multi,
      aes(fill = group),
      scale = "width", trim = TRUE, color = "#5A4A62", linewidth = 0.3,
      adjust = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = plot_data$multi,
      width = 0.12, fill = "white", outlier.stroke = 0.5,
      color = "#3D3348", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data$single,
      aes(fill = group),
      shape = 21, size = 2.2, color = "#3D3348", stroke = 0.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data$annotations,
      aes(x = tissue, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.35, angle = 90, hjust = 0
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data$annotations,
      aes(x = tissue, y = significance_y, label = significance),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      position = position_nudge(x = -0.08),
      size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0,
      parse = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_log10(
      breaks = 10^(-2:6),
      labels = scales::label_log(base = 10),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.13))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Endoderm tissue enriched genes" = "#B9A6CB",
        "Other tissue enriched genes" = "#B8B2BC"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = "Expression FC", title = plot_title,
      caption = paste(
        "Up/down arrows: tissue median relative to all other genes;",
        "stars: BH-adjusted Wilcoxon p value."
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 14, 12, 10)
    )
}
```

### HepG2 versus K562 DE counts

```{r hepG2-k562-de-counts-load, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
hepG2_k562_de_counts <- read.table(
  path.expand(
    "~/mnt/scratch/endo_pred/rnaseqdata/with_hepG2_limmaTrend_DEA/up_down_counts_FDR01.txt"
  ),
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
stopifnot(
  hepG2_k562_de_counts$Total ==
    hepG2_k562_de_counts$Up+hepG2_k562_de_counts$Down
)
hepG2_k562_condition_order <- c(
  "S5", "S4", "S3d5", "S3", "S2d5", "S2", "S1d5", "S1"
)
hepG2_k562_de_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    Sample = hepG2_k562_de_counts$Sample,
    Direction = "Higher in HepG2",
    Genes = hepG2_k562_de_counts$Up
  ),
  data.frame(
    Sample = hepG2_k562_de_counts$Sample,
    Direction = "Higher in K562",
    Genes = hepG2_k562_de_counts$Down
  )
)
hepG2_k562_de_long$Sample <- factor(
  hepG2_k562_de_long$Sample,
  levels = hepG2_k562_condition_order
)
hepG2_k562_de_long$Direction <- factor(
  hepG2_k562_de_long$Direction,
  levels = c("Higher in HepG2", "Higher in K562")
)
hepG2_k562_de_long$signed_genes <- ifelse(
  hepG2_k562_de_long$Direction == "Higher in HepG2",
  hepG2_k562_de_long$Genes,
  -hepG2_k562_de_long$Genes
)
```

```{r hepG2-k562-de-diverging-bars, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.3, dpi=300}
ggplot(
  hepG2_k562_de_long,
  aes(x = Sample, y = signed_genes, fill = Direction)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.72, color = "#4B4350", linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = signed_genes+ifelse(signed_genes > 0, 220, -220),
      label = scales::comma(Genes)
    ),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Higher in HepG2" = "#D98C83",
      "Higher in K562" = "#6FAFA8"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "K562",
    y = "Number of DE genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

prepare_tissue_parameter_plot_data <- function(
    parameter_values, min_tissue_n = NULL
) {
  parameter_data <- do.call(rbind, Map(function(tissue_genes, tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- as.character(tissue_genes$Ensembl)
    values <- unname(parameter_values[tissue_gene_ids])
    data.frame(
      tissue = rep(tissue_name, length(values)),
      gene = tissue_gene_ids,
      parameter_value = as.numeric(values),
      endoderm = rep(
        tissue_name %in% tissue_fc_endoderm_names,
        length(values)
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, tissue_fc_gene_lists, tissue_fc_names))
  parameter_data <- parameter_data[
    is.finite(parameter_data$parameter_value),
  ]
  parameter_universe <- parameter_values[is.finite(parameter_values)]
  parameter_universe <- parameter_universe[
    !duplicated(names(parameter_universe))
  ]
  test_tissues <- unique(parameter_data$tissue)
  tissue_p_values <- vapply(test_tissues, function(tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- intersect(
      unique(parameter_data$gene[parameter_data$tissue == tissue_name]),
      names(parameter_universe)
    )
    tissue_values <- unname(parameter_universe[tissue_gene_ids])
    rest_values <- unname(parameter_universe[
      setdiff(names(parameter_universe), tissue_gene_ids)
    ])
    if (length(tissue_values) < 2 || length(rest_values) < 2) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(tissue_values, rest_values, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    )
  }, numeric(1))
  tissue_median_difference <- vapply(test_tissues, function(tissue_name) {
    tissue_gene_ids <- intersect(
      unique(parameter_data$gene[parameter_data$tissue == tissue_name]),
      names(parameter_universe)
    )
    tissue_values <- unname(parameter_universe[tissue_gene_ids])
    rest_values <- unname(parameter_universe[
      setdiff(names(parameter_universe), tissue_gene_ids)
    ])
    median(tissue_values)-median(rest_values)
  }, numeric(1))
  tissue_adjusted_p <- p.adjust(tissue_p_values, method = "BH")
  tissue_significance_stars <- ifelse(
    is.na(tissue_adjusted_p), "",
    ifelse(
      tissue_adjusted_p < 0.001, "***",
      ifelse(
        tissue_adjusted_p < 0.01, "**",
        ifelse(tissue_adjusted_p < 0.05, "*", "")
      )
    )
  )
  tissue_significance <- ifelse(
    tissue_significance_stars == "",
    "phantom()",
    paste0(
      "phantom() ",
      ifelse(tissue_median_difference > 0, "%up%", "%down%"),
      " '", tissue_significance_stars, "'"
    )
  )
  parameter_test_results <- data.frame(
    tissue = test_tissues,
    adjusted_p = tissue_adjusted_p,
    median_difference = tissue_median_difference,
    significance = tissue_significance,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (!is.null(min_tissue_n)) {
    initial_tissue_n <- table(parameter_data$tissue)
    retained_tissues <- names(initial_tissue_n)[
      initial_tissue_n >= min_tissue_n
    ]
    parameter_data <- parameter_data[
      parameter_data$tissue %in% retained_tissues,
    ]
  }
  parameter_data$group <- factor(
    ifelse(
      parameter_data$endoderm,
      "Endoderm tissue enriched genes",
      "Other tissue enriched genes"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Endoderm tissue enriched genes",
      "Other tissue enriched genes"
    )
  )

  parameter_median <- tapply(
    parameter_data$parameter_value,
    parameter_data$tissue,
    median,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  tissue_order <- names(parameter_median)[order(-parameter_median)]
  parameter_tissue_n <- table(parameter_data$tissue)
  high_n_tissues <- names(parameter_tissue_n)[parameter_tissue_n > 10]
  low_n_tissues <- names(parameter_tissue_n)[
    parameter_tissue_n >= 2 & parameter_tissue_n <= 10
  ]
  single_gene_tissue_names <- names(parameter_tissue_n)[
    parameter_tissue_n == 1
  ]
  tissue_order <- c(
    intersect(tissue_order, high_n_tissues),
    intersect(tissue_order, low_n_tissues),
    intersect(tissue_order, single_gene_tissue_names)
  )
  parameter_data$tissue <- factor(
    parameter_data$tissue,
    levels = tissue_order
  )

  tissue_n <- table(parameter_data$tissue)
  multi_gene_tissues <- parameter_data[
    tissue_n[as.character(parameter_data$tissue)] >= 2,
  ]
  single_gene_tissues <- parameter_data[
    tissue_n[as.character(parameter_data$tissue)] < 2,
  ]
  parameter_span <- diff(range(parameter_data$parameter_value))
  if (!is.finite(parameter_span) || parameter_span == 0) {
    parameter_span <- 1
  }
  annotations <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissue_order, function(tissue_name) {
    tissue_values <- parameter_data$parameter_value[
      parameter_data$tissue == tissue_name
    ]
    data.frame(
      tissue = tissue_name,
      y = max(tissue_values)+0.04*parameter_span,
      significance_y = max(tissue_values)+0.01*parameter_span,
      label = paste0("n=", length(tissue_values)),
      adjusted_p = parameter_test_results$adjusted_p[
        match(tissue_name, parameter_test_results$tissue)
      ],
      significance = parameter_test_results$significance[
        match(tissue_name, parameter_test_results$tissue)
      ]
    )
  }))
  annotations$tissue <- factor(annotations$tissue, levels = tissue_order)

  list(
    data = parameter_data,
    multi = multi_gene_tissues,
    single = single_gene_tissues,
    annotations = annotations
  )
}

draw_tissue_parameter_violin <- function(
    parameter_values, y_label, log_y = FALSE,
    min_tissue_n = NULL, plot_title = NULL
) {
  plot_data <- prepare_tissue_parameter_plot_data(
    parameter_values,
    min_tissue_n = min_tissue_n
  )
  if (log_y) {
    plot_data$data <- plot_data$data[plot_data$data$parameter_value > 0, ]
    plot_data$multi <- plot_data$multi[plot_data$multi$parameter_value > 0, ]
    plot_data$single <- plot_data$single[plot_data$single$parameter_value > 0, ]
    plot_data$annotations$y <- vapply(
      levels(plot_data$data$tissue),
      function(tissue_name) {
        max(plot_data$data$parameter_value[
          plot_data$data$tissue == tissue_name
        ])*1.25
      },
      numeric(1)
    )
    plot_data$annotations$significance_y <- vapply(
      levels(plot_data$data$tissue),
      function(tissue_name) {
        max(plot_data$data$parameter_value[
          plot_data$data$tissue == tissue_name
        ])*1.08
      },
      numeric(1)
    )
  }

  p <- ggplot(plot_data$data, aes(x = tissue, y = parameter_value))+
    geom_violin(
      data = plot_data$multi,
      aes(fill = group),
      scale = "width", trim = TRUE, adjust = 0.75,
      color = "#5A4A62", linewidth = 0.3
    )+
    geom_boxplot(
      data = plot_data$multi,
      width = 0.12, fill = "white", outlier.stroke = 0.5,
      color = "#3D3348", linewidth = 0.3
    )+
    geom_point(
      data = plot_data$single,
      aes(fill = group),
      shape = 21, size = 2.2, color = "#3D3348", stroke = 0.3,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )+
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data$annotations,
      aes(x = tissue, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.35, angle = 90, hjust = 0
    )+
    geom_text(
      data = plot_data$annotations,
      aes(x = tissue, y = significance_y, label = significance),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      position = position_nudge(x = -0.08),
      size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0,
      parse = TRUE
    )+
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Endoderm tissue enriched genes" = "#B9A6CB",
        "Other tissue enriched genes" = "#B8B2BC"
      ),
      name = NULL
    )+
    labs(
      x = NULL, y = y_label, title = plot_title,
      caption = paste(
        "Up/down arrows: tissue median relative to all other genes;",
        "stars: BH-adjusted Wilcoxon p value."
      )
    )+
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)+
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 55, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(6, 14, 12, 10)
    )
  if (log_y) {
    p <- p+scale_y_log10(
      labels = scales::label_log(base = 10),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.13))
    )
  } else {
    p <- p+scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.13)))
  }
  p
}

```{r ,  eval=T,fig.width=2, fig.height=2,  echo=F, warning=F, results='show', fig.show='show',message=FALSE, dpi=600}

get_F_EC <- function(x){(x/0.467)^0.5}
get_H_EC <- function(x){(x*0.467)^0.5}
getFH_fromF <- function(x){0.467*x^2}


my_violin <- function(x,y,colors=c("#D9AAB6","#DDB06F"),ylab,log_y=FALSE,hline=NULL){
  groupname <- c("CRE","Gene")
  n <- length(x)
df <- data.frame(
  group = c(rep(groupname[1], each=n),rep(groupname[2],length(y))),
  value = c(x,y)
)
df$group <- factor(df$group, levels = groupname)
names(colors) <- groupname
p_test <- wilcox.test(x[is.finite(x)],y[is.finite(y)],exact=FALSE)
p_label <- paste0("p = ", format.pval(p_test$p.value, digits=2, eps=2.2e-16))
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=group, y=value, fill=group))
if (!is.null(hline)) {
  p <- p + geom_hline(yintercept=hline, col=alpha("black",0.8), linetype=5, linewidth=0.6)
}
p <- p + geom_violin() +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.1,
      fill = "white",
      outlier.size = 0.75
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors)+
  theme(
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
  #axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "none"
  )+labs(
    x = "",
    y = ylab
  )
if (log_y) {
  finite_value <- df$value[is.finite(df$value) & df$value > 0]
  log_range <- range(log10(finite_value))
  log_span <- diff(log_range)
  if (log_span == 0) log_span <- 1
  bracket_y <- 10^(log_range[2]+0.08*log_span)
  bracket_tip_y <- 10^(log_range[2]+0.05*log_span)
  p_value_y <- 10^(log_range[2]+0.15*log_span)
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_tip_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_tip_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate("text",x=1.5,y=p_value_y,label=p_label,size=3) +
    scale_y_log10(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05,0.22)))
} else {
  finite_value <- df$value[is.finite(df$value)]
  value_range <- range(finite_value)
  value_span <- diff(value_range)
  if (value_span == 0) value_span <- max(1,abs(value_range[2]))
  bracket_y <- value_range[2]+0.08*value_span
  bracket_tip_y <- value_range[2]+0.05*value_span
  p_value_y <- value_range[2]+0.15*value_span
  p <- p +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_tip_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate(
      "segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = bracket_y, yend = bracket_tip_y,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    annotate("text",x=1.5,y=p_value_y,label=p_label,size=3) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05,0.22)))
}
p
 # axis.ticks = element_blank())
}

draw_group_legend <- function(colors=c("#D9AAB6","#DDB06F")) {
  groupname <- c("CRE","Gene")
  legend_df <- data.frame(
    group=factor(groupname,levels=groupname),
    value=1
  )
  names(colors) <- groupname
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_df,aes(x=group,y=value,fill=group)) +
    geom_point(shape=22,size=4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=colors) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="group")) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position="right")
  legend_grob <- ggplotGrob(legend_plot)
  legend_index <- which(legend_grob$layout$name == "guide-box-right")
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(legend_grob$grobs[[legend_index]])
}

gff3_attribute <- function(attributes, key) {
  vapply(strsplit(attributes, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(fields) {
    matching_field <- fields[startsWith(fields, paste0(key, "="))]
    if (length(matching_field) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    sub(paste0("^", key, "="), "", matching_field[1])
  }, character(1))
}

)

cherry_set_canvas <- function(x, xlab, xat, xlabels = "") {
  plot(x, (c(1:8)-0.995)*36, log = "xy", pch = 16, cex = 0,
       col = "white", axes = FALSE, ann = FALSE,ylim = c(0.1,25))
  axis(2, at = c(1, 5, 25, 125), lwd = 1, tck = -0.02,
       col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black", padj = 1.8,
       cex.axis = 0.8, las = 3)
  axis(1, at = xat, labels = xlabels, lwd = 1, tck = -0.02,
       col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black", padj = -2,
       cex.axis = 0.8)
  title(ylab = "Activity [a.u.]", xlab = xlab, line = 1.2, cex.lab = 1)
  box()
}

}

merge_cherry_intervals <- function(start, end) {
  interval_order <- order(start, end)
  start <- start[interval_order]
  end <- end[interval_order]
  merged_start <- start[1]
  merged_end <- end[1]

  for (i in seq.int(2, length(start))) {
    last_interval <- length(merged_start)
    if (start[i] <= merged_end[last_interval]) {
      merged_end[last_interval] <- max(merged_end[last_interval], end[i])
    } else {
      merged_start <- c(merged_start, start[i])
      merged_end <- c(merged_end, end[i])
    }
  }
  data.frame(start = merged_start, end = merged_end)
}

      gene_mane_transcript$chromosome != chromosome) {

  }
  gene_model_exon_start <- gene_model_exons$start-1
  gene_model_exon_end <- gene_model_exons$end
  gene_model_cds_start <- if (nrow(gene_model_cds) > 0) {
    min(gene_model_cds$start)-1

  }, numeric(1))
  covered_segments <- is.finite(browser_segment_regP)

  tss_bed <- data.frame(

    ),

  )

  if (gene_name %in% c("APOB", "TUBB")) {
    tested_region_focus_padding <- 300

    original_region_end <- max(gene_all_coordinates$end)+tested_region_focus_padding

    number_of_compressed_gaps <- if (gene_name == "ACTB") 3 else 2
    compression_gaps <- compression_gaps[
      order(compression_gaps$width, decreasing = TRUE)[
        seq_len(number_of_compressed_gaps)
      ],
    ]
    compression_gaps <- compression_gaps[order(compression_gaps$start),]
    retained_gap_flank <- 750
    protected_gene_start <- min(gene_model_exon_start, gene_tss$start)
    protected_gene_end <- max(gene_model_exon_end, gene_tss$end)
    removal_gaps <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(compression_gaps)), function(gap_i) {
      gap_start <- compression_gaps$start[gap_i]
      gap_end <- compression_gaps$end[gap_i]
      removal_start <- gap_start+retained_gap_flank
      removal_end <- gap_end-retained_gap_flank
      overlaps_gene <- gap_start < protected_gene_end & gap_end > protected_gene_start
      if (overlaps_gene) {
        left_candidate <- c(
          removal_start,
          min(removal_end, protected_gene_start-retained_gap_flank)
        )
        right_candidate <- c(
          max(removal_start, protected_gene_end+retained_gap_flank),
          removal_end
        )
        candidates <- rbind(left_candidate, right_candidate)
        candidate_width <- candidates[,2]-candidates[,1]
        best_candidate <- which.max(candidate_width)
        removal_start <- candidates[best_candidate,1]
        removal_end <- candidates[best_candidate,2]
      }
      if (removal_end <= removal_start) {
        stop(paste0("No empty sequence is available for the ", gene_name, " axis break"))
      }
      data.frame(start=removal_start, end=removal_end)
    }))
    if (gene_name == "ARG1") {
      arg1_exon_order <- order(gene_model_exon_start, gene_model_exon_end)
      arg1_exon_start <- gene_model_exon_start[arg1_exon_order]
      arg1_exon_end <- gene_model_exon_end[arg1_exon_order]
      arg1_intron_start <- head(arg1_exon_end, -1)
      arg1_intron_end <- tail(arg1_exon_start, -1)
      arg1_intron_width <- arg1_intron_end-arg1_intron_start
      longest_arg1_intron <- which.max(arg1_intron_width)
      gene_body_break_flank <- 250
      gene_body_removal <- data.frame(
        start = arg1_intron_start[longest_arg1_intron]+gene_body_break_flank,
        end = arg1_intron_end[longest_arg1_intron]-gene_body_break_flank
      )
      if (gene_body_removal$end <= gene_body_removal$start) {
        stop("The longest ARG1 intron is too short for a gene-body break")
      }
      removal_gaps <- rbind(removal_gaps, gene_body_removal)
      removal_gaps <- removal_gaps[order(removal_gaps$start),]
    }
    compress_coordinate <- function(position) {
      compressed <- position
      for (gap_i in seq_len(nrow(removal_gaps))) {
        removal_start <- removal_gaps$start[gap_i]
        removal_end <- removal_gaps$end[gap_i]
        removed_width <- removal_end-removal_start
        inside_removal <- position > removal_start & position < removal_end
        after_removal <- position >= removal_end
        compressed[inside_removal] <- compressed[inside_removal]-
          (position[inside_removal]-removal_start)
        compressed[after_removal] <- compressed[after_removal]-removed_width
      }
      compressed
    }

    regP_bedgraph$start <- compress_coordinate(regP_bedgraph$start)
    regP_bedgraph$end <- compress_coordinate(regP_bedgraph$end)
    tested_region_bed$start <- compress_coordinate(tested_region_bed$start)
    tested_region_bed$end <- compress_coordinate(tested_region_bed$end)
    tss_bed$start <- compress_coordinate(tss_bed$start)
    tss_bed$end <- compress_coordinate(tss_bed$end)
    gene_model_exon_start <- compress_coordinate(gene_model_exon_start)
    gene_model_exon_end <- compress_coordinate(gene_model_exon_end)
    gene_model_cds_start <- compress_coordinate(gene_model_cds_start)
    gene_model_cds_end <- compress_coordinate(gene_model_cds_end)
    region_start <- compress_coordinate(original_region_start)
    region_end <- compress_coordinate(original_region_end)
    compressed_break_positions <- compress_coordinate(
      (removal_gaps$start+removal_gaps$end)/2
    )

    if (gene_name == "ACTB") {
      retained_section_start <- c(original_region_start, compression_gaps$end)
      retained_section_end <- c(compression_gaps$start, original_region_end)
      original_ticks <- round(
        (retained_section_start+retained_section_end)/2000
      )*1000
    } else {
      original_ticks <- sort(unique(c(
        round(original_region_start/1000)*1000,
        round(merged_tested_intervals$start/1000)*1000,
        round(merged_tested_intervals$end/1000)*1000,
        round(original_region_end/1000)*1000
      )))
    }
    original_ticks <- original_ticks[
      original_ticks >= original_region_start &
        original_ticks <= original_region_end
    ]
    compressed_ticks <- compress_coordinate(original_ticks)
    if (gene_name %in% c("ARG1", "ACTB") && length(compressed_ticks) > 1) {
      minimum_tick_spacing <- if (gene_name == "ACTB") {
        0.12*(region_end-region_start)
      } else {
        0.08*(region_end-region_start)
      }
      tick_groups <- cumsum(c(
        1,
        diff(compressed_ticks) >= minimum_tick_spacing
      ))
      tick_keep <- vapply(
        unique(tick_groups),
        function(group_id) which(tick_groups == group_id)[1],
        integer(1)
      )
      tick_keep[length(tick_keep)] <- tail(
        which(tick_groups == max(tick_groups)), 1
      )
      original_ticks <- original_ticks[tick_keep]
      compressed_ticks <- compressed_ticks[tick_keep]
    }
    tick_labels <- format(original_ticks/1000, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
    tick_labels[length(tick_labels)] <- paste0(tail(tick_labels, 1), "~Kb")
    command_environment <- c(
      paste0("BROKEN_X_TICKS=", paste(compressed_ticks, collapse = ",")),
      paste0("BROKEN_X_LABELS=", paste(tick_labels, collapse = ":"))
    )
  }

  gene_model_exon_start <- round(gene_model_exon_start)
  gene_model_exon_end <- round(gene_model_exon_end)
  gene_model_cds_start <- round(gene_model_cds_start)
  gene_model_cds_end <- round(gene_model_cds_end)
  gene_model_exon_order <- order(gene_model_exon_start, gene_model_exon_end)
  gene_model_exon_start <- gene_model_exon_start[gene_model_exon_order]
  gene_model_exon_end <- gene_model_exon_end[gene_model_exon_order]
  gene_model_start <- min(gene_model_exon_start)
  gene_model_end <- max(gene_model_exon_end)
  gene_model_bed <- data.frame(
    chromosome = chromosome,
    start = gene_model_start,
    end = gene_model_end,
    name = gene_name,
    score = 0,
    strand = gene_mane_transcript$strand,
    thickStart = gene_model_cds_start,
    thickEnd = gene_model_cds_end,
    itemRgb = "90,90,90",
    blockCount = length(gene_model_exon_start),
    blockSizes = paste0(
      paste(gene_model_exon_end-gene_model_exon_start, collapse = ","), ","
    ),
    blockStarts = paste0(
      paste(gene_model_exon_start-gene_model_start, collapse = ","), ","
    )
  )

  write.table(regP_bedgraph, regP_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(tested_region_bed, tested_region_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(tss_bed, tss_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  write.table(gene_model_bed, gene_model_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
              row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
  region_padding <- ceiling((region_end-region_start)*0.02)
  cherry_browser_specs[[gene_name]] <- list(
    chromosome = chromosome,
    region_start = region_start,
    region_end = region_end,
    region_padding = region_padding,
    command_environment = command_environment,
    compressed_break_positions = compressed_break_positions
  )
  command_output <- system2(
    pygenometracks_python,
    args = c(
      shQuote(pygenometracks_wrapper),
      "--tracks", shQuote(config_file),
      "--region", paste0(chromosome, ":", region_start-region_padding,
                         "-", region_end+region_padding),
      "--outFileName", shQuote(image_file),
      "--title", shQuote(gene_name),
      "--width", "20",
      "--height", "10",
      "--dpi", "300",
      "--fontSize", "6",
      "--trackLabelFraction", "0.18"
    ),
    env = command_environment,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  if (!is.null(attr(command_output, "status")) && attr(command_output, "status") != 0) {
    clean_command_output <- unlist(strsplit(command_output, "\r", fixed = TRUE))
    stop(paste(tail(clean_command_output, 40), collapse = "\n"))
  }
  if (!file.exists(image_file)) {
    clean_command_output <- unlist(strsplit(command_output, "\r", fixed = TRUE))
    stop(paste0(
      "pyGenomeTracks did not create ", image_file, "\n",
      paste(tail(clean_command_output, 40), collapse = "\n")
    ))
  }
  panel_png <- png::readPNG(image_file)
  panel_height <- dim(panel_png)[1]
  panel_width <- dim(panel_png)[2]
  panel_rgb <- panel_png[,,1:3, drop = FALSE]
  dark_pixels <- apply(panel_rgb, c(1, 2), max) < 0.2

  longest_true_run <- function(x) {
    runs <- rle(x)
    run_end <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
    run_start <- run_end-runs$lengths+1
    true_runs <- which(runs$values)
    longest <- true_runs[which.max(runs$lengths[true_runs])]
    c(run_start[longest], run_end[longest])
  }

  lower_rows <- seq.int(round(panel_height*0.65), round(panel_height*0.95))
  coordinate_axis_row <- lower_rows[
    which.max(rowSums(dark_pixels[lower_rows, , drop = FALSE]))
  ]
  plot_horizontal_range <- longest_true_run(dark_pixels[coordinate_axis_row,])
  plot_right <- plot_horizontal_range[2]

  upper_rows <- seq_len(round(panel_height*0.68))
  left_columns <- seq_len(round(panel_width*0.10))
  regP_axis_counts <- colSums(
    dark_pixels[upper_rows, left_columns, drop = FALSE]
  )
  plot_left <- left_columns[which.max(regP_axis_counts)]
  regP_vertical_range <- longest_true_run(dark_pixels[,plot_left])
  plot_top <- regP_vertical_range[1]
  regP_bottom <- regP_vertical_range[2]

  tested_gray <-
    abs(panel_png[,,1]-189/255) < 0.06 &
    abs(panel_png[,,2]-189/255) < 0.06 &
    abs(panel_png[,,3]-189/255) < 0.06
  tested_search_rows <- seq.int(
    regP_bottom+1,
    round(panel_height*0.78)
  )
  tested_row_counts <- rowSums(
    tested_gray[tested_search_rows, plot_left:plot_right, drop = FALSE]
  )
  tested_rows <- tested_search_rows[
    tested_row_counts > 0.2*max(tested_row_counts)
  ]
  tss_red <-
    abs(panel_png[,,1]-232/255) < 0.08 &
    abs(panel_png[,,2]-111/255) < 0.08 &
    abs(panel_png[,,3]-119/255) < 0.08
  tss_search_rows <- seq.int(
    max(tested_rows)+1,
    round(panel_height*0.84)
  )
  tss_rows <- tss_search_rows[
    rowSums(tss_red[tss_search_rows, plot_left:plot_right, drop = FALSE]) > 0
  ]
  gene_gray <-
    abs(panel_png[,,1]-90/255) < 0.08 &
    abs(panel_png[,,2]-90/255) < 0.08 &
    abs(panel_png[,,3]-90/255) < 0.08
  gene_search_rows <- seq.int(
    max(tss_rows)+1,
    round(panel_height*0.88)
  )
  gene_candidate_rows <- gene_search_rows[
    rowSums(gene_gray[gene_search_rows, plot_left:plot_right, drop = FALSE]) > 0
  ]
  gene_row_groups <- cumsum(c(1, diff(gene_candidate_rows) > 1))
  gene_rows <- gene_candidate_rows[
    gene_row_groups == min(gene_row_groups)
  ]
  rows_below_gene <- seq.int(max(gene_rows)+4, coordinate_axis_row-1)
  dark_rows_below_gene <- rows_below_gene[
    rowSums(dark_pixels[
      rows_below_gene, plot_left:plot_right, drop = FALSE
    ]) > 0
  ]
  if (length(dark_rows_below_gene) > 0) {
    dark_row_groups <- cumsum(c(1, diff(dark_rows_below_gene) > 1))
    chromosome_label_rows <- dark_rows_below_gene[
      dark_row_groups == min(dark_row_groups)
    ]
    plot_bottom <- floor(
      (max(gene_rows)+min(chromosome_label_rows))/2
    )
  } else {
    plot_bottom <- max(gene_rows)+6
  }

  box_width <- 4
  panel_png[plot_top:(plot_top+box_width-1), plot_left:plot_right, 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[(plot_bottom-box_width+1):plot_bottom, plot_left:plot_right, 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[plot_top:plot_bottom, plot_left:(plot_left+box_width-1), 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[plot_top:plot_bottom, (plot_right-box_width+1):plot_right, 1:3] <- 0

  if (gene_name %in% c("ARG1", "ACTB")) {
    display_start <- region_start-region_padding
    display_end <- region_end+region_padding
    break_columns <- round(
      plot_left+(compressed_break_positions-display_start)/
        (display_end-display_start)*(plot_right-plot_left)
    )

    for (break_column in break_columns) {
      for (slash_shift in c(-5, 5)) {
        for (offset in -6:6) {
          row_here <- coordinate_axis_row-offset
          column_here <- break_column+slash_shift+offset%/%2
          panel_png[
            max(1, row_here-1):min(dim(panel_png)[1], row_here+1),
            max(1, column_here-1):min(dim(panel_png)[2], column_here+1),
            1:3
          ] <- 0
        }
      }
    }
  }
  png::writePNG(panel_png, image_file)
  asset_image_file <- file.path(cherry_browser_asset_dir, basename(image_file))
  copied_image <- file.copy(image_file, asset_image_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(copied_image) || !file.exists(asset_image_file)) {
    stop(paste0("Could not save the generated browser image: ", asset_image_file))
  }
  cherry_browser_images <- c(cherry_browser_images, asset_image_file)
}

knitr::include_graphics(cherry_browser_images, rel_path = FALSE)

  if (length(dark_rows_below_gene) > 0) {
    dark_row_groups <- cumsum(c(1, diff(dark_rows_below_gene) > 1))
    chromosome_label_rows <- dark_rows_below_gene[
      dark_row_groups == min(dark_row_groups)
    ]
    plot_bottom <- floor((max(gene_rows)+min(chromosome_label_rows))/2)
  } else {
    plot_bottom <- max(gene_rows)+6
  }

  box_width <- 4
  panel_png[plot_top:(plot_top+box_width-1), plot_left:plot_right, 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[(plot_bottom-box_width+1):plot_bottom, plot_left:plot_right, 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[plot_top:plot_bottom, plot_left:(plot_left+box_width-1), 1:3] <- 0
  panel_png[plot_top:plot_bottom, (plot_right-box_width+1):plot_right, 1:3] <- 0

  if (gene_name %in% c("ARG1", "ACTB")) {
    display_start <- browser_spec$region_start-browser_spec$region_padding
    display_end <- browser_spec$region_end+browser_spec$region_padding
    break_columns <- round(
      plot_left+(browser_spec$compressed_break_positions-display_start)/
        (display_end-display_start)*(plot_right-plot_left)
    )
    for (break_column in break_columns) {
      for (slash_shift in c(-5, 5)) {
        for (offset in -6:6) {
          row_here <- coordinate_axis_row-offset
          column_here <- break_column+slash_shift+offset%/%2
          panel_png[
            max(1, row_here-1):min(dim(panel_png)[1], row_here+1),
            max(1, column_here-1):min(dim(panel_png)[2], column_here+1),
            1:3
          ] <- 0
        }
      }
    }
  }
  png::writePNG(panel_png, synergy_image_file)
  asset_image_file <- file.path(
    cherry_synergy_asset_dir, basename(synergy_image_file)
  )
  copied_image <- file.copy(synergy_image_file, asset_image_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(copied_image) || !file.exists(asset_image_file)) {
    stop(paste0("Could not save the generated browser image: ", asset_image_file))
  }
  cherry_synergy_images <- c(cherry_synergy_images, asset_image_file)
}

knitr::include_graphics(cherry_synergy_images, rel_path = FALSE)
```

writeLines(combined_wrapper_lines, cherry_combined_wrapper)

cherry_combined_images <- character(0)
for (gene_name in cherry_gene_order) {
  browser_spec <- cherry_browser_specs[[gene_name]]
  chromosome <- browser_spec$chromosome
  regP_file <- file.path(
    cherry_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_regP.bedgraph")
  )
  synergy_file <- file.path(
    cherry_synergy_browser_dir,
    paste0(gene_name, "_regP_synergy.bedgraph")
  )
  tested_region_file <- file.path(
    cherry_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_tested_region.bed")
  )
  tss_file <- file.path(
    cherry_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_TSS.bed")
  )
  gene_model_file <- file.path(
    cherry_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_MANE_gene_model.bed")
  )
  source_config_file <- file.path(
    cherry_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_tracks.ini")
  )
  if (!all(file.exists(c(
    regP_file, synergy_file, tested_region_file, tss_file,
    gene_model_file, source_config_file
  )))) {
    stop(paste0("The source browser files are missing for ", gene_name))
  }

  combined_regP_file <- regP_file
  combined_synergy_file <- synergy_file
  combined_tested_region_file <- tested_region_file
  combined_tss_file <- tss_file
  combined_gene_model_file <- gene_model_file
  combined_region_start <- browser_spec$region_start
  combined_region_end <- browser_spec$region_end
  combined_region_padding <- browser_spec$region_padding
  combined_break_positions <- browser_spec$compressed_break_positions
  combined_command_environment <- browser_spec$command_environment

  if (gene_name == "ARG1") {
    arg1_gene_model <- read.table(
      gene_model_file,
      sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE
    )
    if (nrow(arg1_gene_model) != 1 || ncol(arg1_gene_model) < 12) {
      stop("Expected one BED12 ARG1 gene model for the combined-track break")
    }
    arg1_block_sizes <- as.numeric(strsplit(
      sub(",+$", "", arg1_gene_model[1, 11]), ",", fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]])
    arg1_block_starts <- as.numeric(strsplit(
      sub(",+$", "", arg1_gene_model[1, 12]), ",", fixed = TRUE
    )[[1]])
    arg1_exon_start <- arg1_gene_model[1, 2]+arg1_block_starts
    arg1_exon_end <- arg1_exon_start+arg1_block_sizes
    arg1_intron_start <- head(arg1_exon_end, -1)
    arg1_intron_end <- tail(arg1_exon_start, -1)
    arg1_tested_intervals <- read.table(
      tested_region_file,
      sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    arg1_untested_intron_segments <- do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(seq_along(arg1_intron_start), function(intron_i) {
        intron_start <- arg1_intron_start[intron_i]
        intron_end <- arg1_intron_end[intron_i]
        overlapping_tested <- arg1_tested_intervals[
          arg1_tested_intervals[[2]] < intron_end &
            arg1_tested_intervals[[3]] > intron_start,
          , drop = FALSE
        ]
        boundaries <- sort(unique(c(
          intron_start,
          intron_end,
          pmax(intron_start, overlapping_tested[[2]]),
          pmin(intron_end, overlapping_tested[[3]])
        )))
        if (length(boundaries) < 2) return(NULL)
        segment_start <- head(boundaries, -1)
        segment_end <- tail(boundaries, -1)
        segment_midpoint <- (segment_start+segment_end)/2
        overlaps_tested <- vapply(segment_midpoint, function(position) {
          any(
            arg1_tested_intervals[[2]] <= position &
              arg1_tested_intervals[[3]] > position
          )
        }, logical(1))
        data.frame(
          start = segment_start[!overlaps_tested],
          end = segment_end[!overlaps_tested]
        )
      })
    )
    # Compress every remaining sizeable untested ARG1 intron, rather than only
    # the single longest one, so the gene body is visibly shortened while all
    # exons and tested CREs remain at full width.
    arg1_extra_break_flank <- 100
    arg1_untested_intron_segments$width <-
      arg1_untested_intron_segments$end-
      arg1_untested_intron_segments$start
    arg1_untested_intron_segments <- arg1_untested_intron_segments[
      arg1_untested_intron_segments$width > 2*arg1_extra_break_flank,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(arg1_untested_intron_segments) == 0) {
      stop("No additional untested ARG1 intronic segment is available")
    }
    arg1_extra_removals <- data.frame(
      start = arg1_untested_intron_segments$start+arg1_extra_break_flank,
      end = arg1_untested_intron_segments$end-arg1_extra_break_flank
    )
    arg1_extra_removals <- arg1_extra_removals[
      order(arg1_extra_removals$start), , drop = FALSE
    ]
    compress_arg1_combined <- function(position) {
      compressed <- position
      for (removal_i in seq_len(nrow(arg1_extra_removals))) {
        removal_start <- arg1_extra_removals$start[removal_i]
        removal_end <- arg1_extra_removals$end[removal_i]
        removed_width <- removal_end-removal_start
        inside_removal <- position > removal_start & position < removal_end
        after_removal <- position >= removal_end
        compressed[inside_removal] <- compressed[inside_removal]-
          (position[inside_removal]-removal_start)
        compressed[after_removal] <-
          compressed[after_removal]-removed_width
      }
      compressed
    }

    compress_interval_file <- function(source_file, destination_file) {
      interval_data <- read.table(
        source_file,
        sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE
      )
      interval_data[[2]] <- compress_arg1_combined(interval_data[[2]])
      interval_data[[3]] <- compress_arg1_combined(interval_data[[3]])
      interval_data <- interval_data[
        interval_data[[3]] > interval_data[[2]],
        , drop = FALSE
      ]
      write.table(
        interval_data, destination_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
        row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE
      )
    }

    combined_regP_file <- file.path(
      cherry_combined_browser_dir, "ARG1_regP_extra_break.bedgraph"
    )
    combined_synergy_file <- file.path(
      cherry_combined_browser_dir, "ARG1_synergy_extra_break.bedgraph"
    )
    combined_tested_region_file <- file.path(
      cherry_combined_browser_dir, "ARG1_tested_region_extra_break.bed"
    )
    combined_tss_file <- file.path(
      cherry_combined_browser_dir, "ARG1_TSS_extra_break.bed"
    )
    combined_gene_model_file <- file.path(
      cherry_combined_browser_dir, "ARG1_gene_model_extra_break.bed"
    )
    compress_interval_file(regP_file, combined_regP_file)
    compress_interval_file(synergy_file, combined_synergy_file)
    compress_interval_file(
      tested_region_file, combined_tested_region_file
    )
    compress_interval_file(tss_file, combined_tss_file)

    compressed_arg1_exon_start <- compress_arg1_combined(arg1_exon_start)
    compressed_arg1_exon_end <- compress_arg1_combined(arg1_exon_end)
    compressed_arg1_model_start <- min(compressed_arg1_exon_start)
    compressed_arg1_model_end <- max(compressed_arg1_exon_end)
    arg1_gene_model[1, 2] <- compressed_arg1_model_start
    arg1_gene_model[1, 3] <- compressed_arg1_model_end
    arg1_gene_model[1, 7] <- compress_arg1_combined(arg1_gene_model[1, 7])
    arg1_gene_model[1, 8] <- compress_arg1_combined(arg1_gene_model[1, 8])
    arg1_gene_model[1, 10] <- length(compressed_arg1_exon_start)
    arg1_gene_model[1, 11] <- paste0(
      paste(
        compressed_arg1_exon_end-compressed_arg1_exon_start,
        collapse = ","
      ),
      ","
    )
    arg1_gene_model[1, 12] <- paste0(
      paste(
        compressed_arg1_exon_start-compressed_arg1_model_start,
        collapse = ","
      ),
      ","
    )
    write.table(
      arg1_gene_model, combined_gene_model_file,
      sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE
    )

    combined_region_start <- compress_arg1_combined(browser_spec$region_start)
    combined_region_end <- compress_arg1_combined(browser_spec$region_end)
    combined_region_padding <- ceiling(
      (combined_region_end-combined_region_start)*0.02
    )
    combined_break_positions <- sort(unique(c(
      compress_arg1_combined(browser_spec$compressed_break_positions),
      compress_arg1_combined(
        (arg1_extra_removals$start+arg1_extra_removals$end)/2
      )
    )))
    tick_environment_index <- grep(
      "^BROKEN_X_TICKS=", combined_command_environment
    )
    if (length(tick_environment_index) == 1) {
      combined_tick_positions <- as.numeric(strsplit(
        sub(
          "^BROKEN_X_TICKS=", "",
          combined_command_environment[tick_environment_index]
        ),
        ",", fixed = TRUE
      )[[1]])
      combined_command_environment[tick_environment_index] <- paste0(
        "BROKEN_X_TICKS=",
        paste(compress_arg1_combined(combined_tick_positions), collapse = ",")
      )
    }
  }

  combined_tss_label_file <- file.path(
    cherry_combined_browser_dir, paste0(gene_name, "_TSS_only.bed")
  )
  combined_tss_data <- read.table(
    combined_tss_file,
    sep = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE
  )
  combined_tss_data[[4]] <- "TSS"
  write.table(
    combined_tss_data, combined_tss_label_file,
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE
  )
  combined_tss_file <- combined_tss_label_file

  source_config <- readLines(source_config_file)
  downstream_start <- match("[Tested region]", source_config)
  if (is.na(downstream_start)) {
    stop(paste0("The tested-region track is missing for ", gene_name))
  }
  regP_config <- source_config[seq_len(downstream_start-1)]
  downstream_config <- source_config[downstream_start:length(source_config)]
  regP_config <- sub("^title = regP$", "title = RegP", regP_config)
  regP_config <- sub("^fontsize = .*$", "fontsize = 12", regP_config)
  downstream_config <- sub(
    "^fontsize = .*$", "fontsize = 12", downstream_config
  )
  downstream_config <- sub(
    "^title = Tested region$", "title = Tested CREs", downstream_config
  )
  downstream_config <- sub("^title = TSS$", "title =", downstream_config)
  downstream_config <- sub(
    "^title = Gene body$", "title =", downstream_config
  )
  regP_config <- sub(
    paste0("file = ", regP_file),
    paste0("file = ", combined_regP_file),
    regP_config,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  downstream_config <- sub(
    paste0("file = ", tested_region_file),
    paste0("file = ", combined_tested_region_file),
    downstream_config,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  downstream_config <- sub(
    paste0("file = ", tss_file),
    paste0("file = ", combined_tss_file),
    downstream_config,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  downstream_config <- sub(
    paste0("file = ", gene_model_file),
    paste0("file = ", combined_gene_model_file),
    downstream_config,
    fixed = TRUE
  )
  synergy_config <- c(
    "[synergy]",
    paste0("file = ", combined_synergy_file),
    "file_type = bedgraph",
    "title = Synergy",
    "height = 4",
    "color = #8FA77E",
    "negative_color = #F4E1A1",
    "type = fill",
    "min_value = -2",
    "max_value = 4",
    "",
    "[synergy zero]",
    "file_type = hlines",
    "y_values = 0",
    "min_value = -2",
    "max_value = 4",
    "color = black",
    "line_width = 1",
    "show_data_range = false",
    "overlay_previous = share-y",
    "",
    "[spacer]",
    "height = 0.2",
    ""
  )
  combined_config_file <- file.path(
    cherry_combined_browser_dir,
    paste0(gene_name, "_combined_tracks.ini")
  )
  writeLines(
    c(regP_config, synergy_config, downstream_config),
    combined_config_file
  )

  combined_image_file <- file.path(
    cherry_combined_browser_dir,
    paste0(gene_name, "_combined_tracks.pdf")
  )
  if (length(combined_break_positions) > 0) {
    combined_command_environment <- c(
      combined_command_environment,
      paste0(
        "BROKEN_X_BREAKS=",
        paste(combined_break_positions, collapse = ",")
      )
    )
  }
  command_output <- system2(
    pygenometracks_python,
    args = c(
      shQuote(cherry_combined_wrapper),
      "--tracks", shQuote(combined_config_file),
      "--region", paste0(
        chromosome, ":",
        combined_region_start-combined_region_padding, "-",
        combined_region_end+combined_region_padding
      ),
      "--outFileName", shQuote(combined_image_file),
      "--title", shQuote(gene_name),
      "--width", "14.666667",
      "--height", "12",
      "--fontSize", "12",
      "--trackLabelFraction", "0.18"
    ),
    env = combined_command_environment,
    stdout = TRUE,
    stderr = TRUE
  )
  if (!is.null(attr(command_output, "status")) &&
      attr(command_output, "status") != 0) {
    clean_command_output <- unlist(strsplit(command_output, "\r", fixed = TRUE))
    stop(paste(tail(clean_command_output, 40), collapse = "\n"))
  }
  if (!file.exists(combined_image_file)) {
    clean_command_output <- unlist(strsplit(command_output, "\r", fixed = TRUE))
    stop(paste0(
      "pyGenomeTracks did not create ", combined_image_file, "\n",
      paste(tail(clean_command_output, 40), collapse = "\n")
    ))
  }

  asset_image_file <- file.path(
    cherry_combined_asset_dir, basename(combined_image_file)
  )
  copied_image <- file.copy(
    combined_image_file, asset_image_file, overwrite = TRUE
  )
  if (!isTRUE(copied_image) || !file.exists(asset_image_file)) {
    stop(paste0("Could not save the generated browser image: ", asset_image_file))
  }
  cherry_combined_images <- c(cherry_combined_images, asset_image_file)
}

knitr::include_graphics(cherry_combined_images, rel_path = FALSE)

  all(cre_feature_ec50_n10$FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_mean > 0),
  all(is.finite(
    cre_feature_ec50_n10$FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_sum
  )),
  all(cre_feature_ec50_n10$FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_sum > 0),
  all(is.finite(
    cre_feature_ec50_n10$F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_mean
  )),
  all(is.finite(
    cre_feature_ec50_n10$F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_sum
  )),
  all(is.finite(
    cre_feature_ec50_n10$non_FH_TF_motif_count_link_score_weighted_mean
  ))
)
cre_feature_ec50_n10$group <- factor(
  cre_feature_ec50_n10$group,
  levels = c("bottom", "top"),
  labels = c("Bottom 10%", "Top 10%")
)
cre_feature_ec50_n10$outcome <- factor(
  cre_feature_ec50_n10$outcome,
  levels = "EC50"
)

cre_feature_all_columns <- c(
  "gene_id", "group", "outcome",
  "FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_mean",
  "FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_sum",
  "F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_mean",
  "F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_sum",
  "non_FH_TF_motif_count_link_score_weighted_mean"
)
cre_feature_all_n10 <- rbind(
  cre_feature_n10[, cre_feature_all_columns],
  cre_feature_ec50_n10[, cre_feature_all_columns]
)
cre_feature_all_n10$group <- factor(
  cre_feature_all_n10$group,
  levels = c("Bottom 10%", "Top 10%")
)
cre_feature_all_n10$outcome <- factor(
  cre_feature_all_n10$outcome,
  levels = c("regP", "HepG2 synergy", "EC50")
)
cre_feature_group_colors <- c(
  "Bottom 10%" = "#B8B2BC",
  "Top 10%" = "#B9A6CB"
)

cre_feature_test_columns <- c(
  "FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_mean",
  "FxH_affinity_link_score_weighted_sum",
  "F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_mean",
  "F_plus_H_binding_sites_link_score_weighted_sum",
  "non_FH_TF_motif_count_link_score_weighted_mean"
)
cre_feature_tests <- expand.grid(
  value_column = cre_feature_test_columns,
  outcome = levels(cre_feature_all_n10$outcome),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
cre_feature_tests$p_value <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(cre_feature_tests)),
  function(i) {
    panel_data <- cre_feature_all_n10[
      cre_feature_all_n10$outcome == cre_feature_tests$outcome[i],
    ]
    wilcox.test(
      panel_data[[cre_feature_tests$value_column[i]]]~panel_data$group,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value
  },
  numeric(1)
)
cre_feature_tests$adjusted_p <- p.adjust(
  cre_feature_tests$p_value,
  method = "BH"
)

plot_cre_feature_boxplots <- function(
  data,
  value_column,
  y_label,
  figure_title,
  log_y = FALSE,
  affinity_energy_axis = FALSE,
  energy_ticks = c(-20, -21, -22)
) {
  outcome_levels <- levels(data$outcome)
  group_levels <- levels(data$group)
  box_width <- 0.58
  old_par <- par(
    mfrow = c(1, length(outcome_levels)),
    mar = c(3.8, 3.6, 2.2, 0.7),
    oma = c(0, 0.2, 1.1, 0)
  )
  # Base R silently sets cex = 0.66 for layouts with three columns.
  # Reset it so three-panel and two-panel figures use identical sizing.
  par(cex = 1)
  on.exit(par(old_par))

  for (outcome_name in outcome_levels) {
    panel_data <- droplevels(data[data$outcome == outcome_name,])
    panel_values <- panel_data[[value_column]]
    panel_group_colors <- cre_feature_group_colors
    if (outcome_name == "HepG2 synergy") {
      panel_group_colors["Top 10%"] <- "#B7D0B3"
    }
    if (outcome_name == "EC50") {
      panel_group_colors["Top 10%"] <- "#F6BE8A"
    }
    if (log_y && any(panel_values <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      stop(value_column, " contains non-positive values")
    }

    finite_values <- panel_values[is.finite(panel_values)]
    if (log_y) {
      transformed_range <- range(log10(finite_values))
      transformed_span <- diff(transformed_range)
      if (transformed_span == 0) transformed_span <- 1
      y_limits <- 10^c(
        transformed_range[1],
        transformed_range[2]+0.38*transformed_span
      )
      bracket_y <- 10^(transformed_range[2]+0.12*transformed_span)
      bracket_tip_y <- 10^(transformed_range[2]+0.08*transformed_span)
      p_value_y <- 10^(transformed_range[2]+0.27*transformed_span)
    } else {
      value_range <- range(finite_values)
      value_span <- diff(value_range)
      if (value_span == 0) value_span <- max(1, abs(value_range[2]))
      y_limits <- c(value_range[1], value_range[2]+0.38*value_span)
      bracket_y <- value_range[2]+0.12*value_span
      bracket_tip_y <- value_range[2]+0.08*value_span
      p_value_y <- value_range[2]+0.27*value_span
    }

    boxplot(
      panel_values~panel_data$group,
      log = if (log_y) "y" else "",
      ylim = y_limits,
      col = unname(panel_group_colors[group_levels]),
      border = "black",
      axes = FALSE,
      ann = FALSE,
      lwd = 0.75,
      medlwd = 0.8,
      boxwex = box_width
    )
    if (affinity_energy_axis) {
      gas_constant_kcal <- 1.987204/1000
      energy_tick_positions <- 1/(
        exp(energy_ticks/(298*gas_constant_kcal))*10^18
      )
      axis(
        2,
        at = energy_tick_positions,
        labels = -energy_ticks,
        lwd = 1,
        tck = -0.025,
        col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
        col.ticks = "black",
        padj = 1.7,
        cex.axis = 0.8,
        las = 3
      )
    } else {
      axis(
        2,
        lwd = 1,
        tck = -0.025,
        col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
        col.ticks = "black",
        padj = 1.7,
        cex.axis = 0.8,
        las = 3
      )
    }
    axis(
      1,
      at = seq_along(group_levels),
      labels = group_levels,
      lwd = 1,
      tck = -0.025,
      col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0),
      col.ticks = "black",
      padj = -1.9,
      cex.axis = 0.8,
      gap.axis = -1
    )
    title(
      main = outcome_name,
      line = 1.2,
      cex.main = 0.9
    )
    if (outcome_name == outcome_levels[1]) {
      mtext(y_label, side = 2, line = 1.2, cex = 0.9)
    }
    adjusted_p <- cre_feature_tests$adjusted_p[
      cre_feature_tests$value_column == value_column &
        cre_feature_tests$outcome == outcome_name
    ]
    segments(1, bracket_y, 2, bracket_y, lwd = 0.75)
    segments(1, bracket_y, 1, bracket_tip_y, lwd = 0.75)
    segments(2, bracket_y, 2, bracket_tip_y, lwd = 0.75)
    text(
      1.5,
      p_value_y,
      labels = paste0(
        "p = ",
        format.pval(adjusted_p, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300)
      ),
      cex = 0.8
    )
    box()
  }
  mtext(figure_title, side = 3, outer = TRUE, line = 0.1, cex = 0.9)
}

roc_line_colors <- c(
  "RegP" = "#4F315E",
  "HepG2 synergy" = "#5F7654",
  "EC50" = "#D99A5F"
)
roc_band_colors <- c(

old_par <- par(

  pty = "s",
  bg = NA
)
par(cex = 1)

for (outcome_name in c("RegP", "HepG2 synergy", "EC50")) {
  roc_line_color <- unname(roc_line_colors[outcome_name])
  roc_band_color <- unname(roc_band_colors[outcome_name])
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
    xlab = "", ylab = "",
    axes = FALSE,
    main = ""
  )
  axis(
    1, at = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.025,
    col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black",
    padj = -2, cex.axis = 0.8
  )
  axis(
    2, at = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.025,
    col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black",
    padj = 1.7, cex.axis = 0.8, las = 3
  )
  abline(h = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), col = "lightgray", lwd = 0.75)
  box()
  abline(0, 1, col = "#B8B2BC", lty = 3, lwd = 0.75)

  curve_data <- customized_feature_roc[
    customized_feature_roc$outcome == outcome_name &
      customized_feature_roc$percentile == 10,
  ]
  curve_data <- curve_data[order(curve_data$point), ]
  ci_data <- customized_feature_roc_ci[
    customized_feature_roc_ci$outcome == outcome_name,
  ]
  ci_data <- ci_data[order(ci_data$false_positive_rate), ]

  polygon(

    c(ci_data$tpr_lower, rev(ci_data$tpr_upper)),
    col = roc_band_color,

    col = roc_line_color,

  panel_title <- if (outcome_name == "HepG2 synergy") "Synergy" else outcome_name
  title(main = panel_title, line = 0.7, cex.main = 0.9)
  auc_value <- unique(curve_data$auc)
  stopifnot(length(auc_value) == 1, is.finite(auc_value))
  text(
    x = 0.97, y = 0.16,
    labels = sprintf("AUC=%.3f", auc_value),
    adj = c(1, 0), cex = 0.68
  )
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = "95% CI",
    col = roc_band_color,
    pch = 15,
    pt.cex = 1.6,
    cex = 0.68,
    bty = "n",
    inset = c(0.015, 0.01)
  )
}

```{r customized-feature-importance-table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=5.4, fig.cap="Held-out permutation importance for the N = 10% models. All features in each group were permuted together. Gray rows have a 95% confidence-interval lower bound below zero."}
make_importance_table <- function(outcome_name) {
  table_data <- customized_feature_importance[
    customized_feature_importance$outcome == outcome_name,
  ]
  table_data <- table_data[order(table_data$rank), ]
  display_data <- data.frame(
    `Feature group` = table_data$family_label,
    `Delta AUC (95% CI)` = table_data$delta_auc_ci,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  names(display_data)[1] <- outcome_name
  header_colors <- c(
    "RegP" = "#9075AB",
    "Synergy" = "#8FA77E",
    "EC50" = "#D99A5F"
  )

  table_theme <- gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
    base_size = 6.8,
    core = list(
      fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.03),
      bg_params = list(
        fill = ifelse(table_data$ci95_lower < 0, "#D9D9D9", "white"),
        col = NA
      )
    ),
    colhead = list(
      fg_params = list(col = "white", fontface = "bold"),
      bg_params = list(fill = unname(header_colors[outcome_name]), col = NA)
    ),
    padding = grid::unit(c(3.5, 4), "pt")
  )
  table_grob <- gridExtra::tableGrob(
    display_data,
    rows = NULL,
    theme = table_theme
  )
  table_grob$widths <- grid::unit(c(5.0, 3.45), "cm")
  table_grob
}

importance_table_top <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  make_importance_table("RegP"),
  make_importance_table("Synergy"),
  ncol = 2
)
importance_table_bottom <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  grid::nullGrob(),
  make_importance_table("EC50"),
  grid::nullGrob(),
  ncol = 3,
  widths = c(0.5, 1, 0.5)
)
gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  importance_table_top,
  importance_table_bottom,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1)
)
```

    breaks = c("RegP", "Synergy")
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(importance_feature_order),
    labels = rev(importance_feature_order),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.45, 0.45))
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.001)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = expression(Delta*"AUC after feature permutation"),
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black", size = 8),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "black", size = 7.5),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8.5),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = -2),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 2, 4)
  ) +
  ggbreak::scale_x_break(c(0.02, 0.09), scales = 1, space = 0.10)

print(importance_figure_regp_synergy)

```{r customized-feature-roc-all-percentiles, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=3.2, out.width='7.5in', fig.align='center', dpi=300}
roc_percentiles <- c(5, 10, 20, 30, 33, 50)
roc_colors_by_outcome <- list(
  "RegP" = setNames(
    grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#4F315E", "#B9A6CB"))(
      length(roc_percentiles)
    ),
    roc_percentiles
  ),
  "HepG2 synergy" = setNames(
    grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#5F7654", "#B7D0B3"))(
      length(roc_percentiles)
    ),
    roc_percentiles
  ),
  "EC50" = setNames(
    grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#D99A5F", "#F6BE8A"))(
      length(roc_percentiles)
    ),
    roc_percentiles
  )
)
roc_line_types <- setNames(c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), roc_percentiles)

old_par <- par(
  mfrow = c(1, 3),
  mar = c(3.3, 3.5, 2.2, 0.7),
  oma = c(1.2, 1.5, 0, 0),
  pty = "s",
  bg = NA
)
par(cex = 1)

for (outcome_name in c("RegP", "HepG2 synergy", "EC50")) {
  roc_colors <- roc_colors_by_outcome[[outcome_name]]
  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1),
    xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i",
    xlab = "", ylab = "",
    axes = FALSE,
    main = ""
  )
  axis(
    1, at = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.025,
    col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black",
    padj = -2, cex.axis = 0.8
  )
  axis(
    2, at = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
    lwd = 1, tck = -0.025,
    col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0), col.ticks = "black",
    padj = 1.7, cex.axis = 0.8, las = 3
  )
  abline(h = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), col = "lightgray", lwd = 0.75)
  box()
  abline(0, 1, col = "#B8B2BC", lty = 3, lwd = 0.75)

  for (percentile_value in rev(roc_percentiles)) {
    curve_data <- customized_feature_roc[
      customized_feature_roc$outcome == outcome_name &
        customized_feature_roc$percentile == percentile_value,
    ]
    curve_data <- curve_data[order(curve_data$point), ]
    lines(
      curve_data$false_positive_rate,
      curve_data$true_positive_rate,
      col = roc_colors[as.character(percentile_value)],
      lty = roc_line_types[as.character(percentile_value)],
      lwd = 1.5
    )
  }

  auc_values <- vapply(roc_percentiles, function(percentile_value) {
    unique(customized_feature_roc$auc[
      customized_feature_roc$outcome == outcome_name &
        customized_feature_roc$percentile == percentile_value
    ])
  }, numeric(1))
  panel_title <- if (outcome_name == "HepG2 synergy") "Synergy" else outcome_name
  title(main = panel_title, line = 0.7, cex.main = 0.9)
  legend(
    "bottomright",
    legend = sprintf("N=%d  AUC=%.3f", roc_percentiles, auc_values),
    col = roc_colors[as.character(roc_percentiles)],
    lty = roc_line_types[as.character(roc_percentiles)],
    lwd = 1.5,
    cex = 0.64,
    bty = "n",
    inset = c(0.015, 0.01),
    y.intersp = 0.9,
    seg.len = 2.1
  )
}

mtext("False-positive rate", side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 0.15, cex = 0.9)
mtext("True-positive rate", side = 2, outer = TRUE, line = 0.25, cex = 0.9)
par(old_par)
